text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган has won the Kikuka
Sho with
ease. A reporter named
Otonashi comes to
interview her.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
During the interview, Маяно Топ Ган
talks
about Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Otonashi follows up by asking if she is
planning
on racing in the Arima Kinen,
the next race Narita
Brian will compete
in.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Маяно Топ Ган replies that she will
race there if
it means competing directly
against Нарита Брайан.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
